history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-21: the owner, on the first pilot of borg-zoo#583 having been dispatched at 9cbe0348 before its pin could be moved: "let the first pilot finish, then run a second at af70b9e9".
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, after the gate of run 44916022689 (borg-zoo#583: 36 of 36 cells finished, 0 deaths, 14 of 18 games
identical, change arm at 9cbe0348) and before any result of this build was read. A second pilot (RULES 16) of the same
definition with the change arm at the final head af70b9e9. Two differences from 9cbe0348: the take-off guard is kept per
slot, per item and per level (it matters only when a take-off is refused), and slowness is no longer one of the curses
taken off at once (owner's decision). The control cells are the same build as in run 44916022689 and are expected to
play identically.
Gate: as #583's: no config_error; one binary per specimen; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; no stall
(no frozen game clock, no wall timeout the control does not have); the sanity cells reproduce.
Report: per arm and per class deaths and causes, CL at death, deepest level; paired rescued / newly killed; the number
of games identical in both arms; and, new here, the change arm against the change arm of run 44916022689 (9cbe0348 against
af70b9e9) start by start: expected identical in all 18 (no start of classes-18 is known to meet a slowness curse or a
refused take-off), and every start that differs is to be named with the first message where the two games part. Per
game, from messages.log and trace-core: "# Removing cursed" notes by curse, "prevents you teleporting" and "aggravating
things" messages, Remove Curse scrolls bought and read, and any "restock remove curse" trip reason (not seen in the first
pilot). Descriptive: 18 starts; no improvement is claimed.
experiment.question: Does borg-reborn-rs#832 at its final head af70b9e9 (the five harmful curses come off at once, per slot, per item and per level; a trip to town for Remove Curse when a removable curse stays worn; no Remove Curse scroll for a pack item worth less than the scroll) play as the first pilot's 9cbe0348 did, without stalls or deaths?
